chapter: Cab Calloway, Harlem and New York musicians
title: Louis Armstrong's reception in New Orleans and the statue dedication
summary: Danny and Smitty recall Armstrong being driven abroad and later mistreated in New Orleans, and Danny's frustration at the statue dedication.
